placement: Engine Library: libraries/fsharp/Limen.Store, released as EchelonFoundry.Limen.Store in lockstep. A pure functional API over the generated limen.store binding: immutable schema, key and range values with total builders; transactions whose mode is a type, so a write cannot be built into a readonly transaction; explicit JSON codecs that round-trip and fail as Undecodable naming store, key and field path; one closed outcome union per request kind; structured StoreError with stable codes and no stored values; a connection state machine that refuses writes locally after Outdated, VersionChanged or ConnectionLost; a forward-only migration planner; diagnostics as values. The only effect is the StoreExecutor the host supplies. Tests and a compile-failure fixture live under conformance/store/fsharp/ and run in npm run test:libraries; the clean-room consumer gains the Store package.
